name: Rooftop Solar & Grid Hybrid System
description: Install rooftop solar PV array to offset grid electricity demand during peak hours, reducing Scope 2 emissions.
explanation: High emission contribution from grid electricity; solar replacement provides clean renewable energy and long-term cost savings.

name: High-Efficiency Biodiesel / Hybrid Generator Upgrade
description: Retrofit existing diesel generators with B20 biodiesel blend kits and smart load control to minimize fuel consumption.
explanation: Directly targets high Scope 1 emissions from diesel combustion with quick implementation and immediate fuel savings.

name: Closed-Loop Recycled Resin Blend Integration
description: Replace up to 40% virgin PET/HDPE granules with certified post-consumer recycled (rPET/rHDPE) flakes.
explanation: Substantial Scope 3 reduction by replacing high-carbon virgin polymers with recycled feedstocks while lowering material procurement costs.

name: In-House Plastic Scrap Granulation & Regrind Loop
description: Install localized edge granulators to process off-cuts and rejected parts directly back into the extrusion feed stream.
explanation: Diverts plastic scrap from landfills while simultaneously replacing virgin resin demand with internal regrind.

name: Recycled Polyester & Organic Cotton Yarn Swap
description: Transition product lines to GOTS-certified organic cotton and rPET yarn blends.
explanation: Organic cotton and recycled synthetic fibers dramatically cut agricultural and petrochemical raw material emissions.

name: Effluent Treatment Plant Sludge Anaerobic Digester
description: Digest textile wastewater sludge anaerobically to capture biogas for process heating.
explanation: Converts high-hazard sludge waste into useful thermal energy, eliminating landfill transport and disposal emissions.

name: Anaerobic Food Waste Digester & Biogas Recovery
description: Process organic spoilage and processing waste on-site to produce biomethane fuel for steam boilers.
explanation: Prevents high-methane organic waste degradation in landfills while reducing fossil natural gas consumption.

name: Milk Logistics Heat Recovery & Thermal Pre-Chilling
description: Utilize plate heat exchangers to capture waste heat from pasteurization steam boilers to pre-heat boiler feedwater.
explanation: Heat recovery captures low-hanging thermal efficiency wins with minimal operational downtime.
